name: homebench
tagline: Benchmark local LLMs with a single command
description: homebench is a tool for benchmarking local language models, measuring speed, memory, and quality with a single command. It builds on the ideas of the related local_bench project and packages them into a focused, easy-to-use benchmark for anyone running models locally with tools like Ollama or llama.cpp. For self-hosters comparing local models, it provides a quick way to see which model performs best on their hardware.
highlights: Benchmarks local LLMs for speed, memory, and quality
Targets Ollama, llama.cpp, and similar local runtimes
A practical tool for self-hosted model selection
curatorNote: Choosing a local model is often a guessing game about performance. homebench turns that into a single command, which is exactly the kind of tool local-AI users need.
